analogy.rationale: The annotated targets CYP11A1/CYP11B1 (steroidogenic enzymes) and ESR1 indicate this antineoplastic class acts mainly through steroidogenesis/estrogen-receptor pathways; ESR1 is expressed in MCF7 but the other lines are largely ER-negative, so the transcriptional response should be weak and most similar to estrogen receptor antagonists and aromatase inhibitors.
